newsitem.title: USA: Fox names Yapp head of worldwide video unit.
newsitem.headline: Fox names Yapp head of worldwide video unit.

text.p: News Corp Ltd's Twentieth Century Fox division named Jeffrey Yapp to the newly-created post of president of worldwide home entertainment.

In a statement, Fox said Yapp, 38, will oversee marketing, sales, distribution, acquisitions and original programming on a global basis. He will also oversee worldwide marketing and distribution of all Fox Interactive products.
Yapp previously was president of the international division of Twentieth Century Home Entertainment.
